package.description: Modern open-source Windows uninstaller with silent uninstall, leftover scan and safe cleanup with undo.

en-US.description: Modern open-source Windows uninstaller with silent uninstall, leftover scan and safe cleanup with undo.
en-US.longDescription:
Vanish is a modern, open-source uninstaller for Windows built with WinUI 3.
It lists classic desktop programs and MSIX/Store apps, derives silent uninstall
switches for MSI, Inno Setup, NSIS and Squirrel installers, uninstalls apps in
a batch queue, and fingerprints each app before uninstalling to find leftover
files, folders and registry entries afterwards. Every cleanup is reversible:
files go to the Recycle Bin and registry keys are backed up to .reg files with
one-click undo. No ads, no bundles, no telemetry.
en-US.name: Vanish

zh-CN.description: 现代开源 Windows 卸载器——静默卸载、残留扫描、可一键撤销的安全清理。
zh-CN.longDescription:
Vanish 是一款基于 WinUI 3 构建的现代开源 Windows 卸载器。
完整列出传统桌面程序与 MSIX/商店应用，自动为 MSI、Inno Setup、NSIS、
Squirrel 安装器推导静默卸载参数，支持批量队列卸载；卸载前先对应用做
指纹采集，卸载后据此扫描残留的文件、目录与注册表项。所有清理均可撤销：
文件进回收站，注册表项自动备份为 .reg，一键还原。无广告、无捆绑、无遥测。
zh-CN.name: Vanish
